prompt: There are $12$ inches in $1$ foot. How many inches in $4.5$ feet?
hint: Every foot contains the same number of inches. When you change from a bigger unit to a smaller one, do you expect more or fewer units?

hints.title: 🔁 Another angle
hints.text: Break the length into a whole number of feet plus half a foot. Half a foot is easy to change into inches by itself.
Every foot contains the same number of inches. When you change from a bigger unit to a smaller one, do you expect more or fewer units?
Each foot is $12$ inches, so multiply the number of feet by $12$: work out $4.5 \times 12$. It may help to split it into $4 \times 12$ and $0.5 \times 12$.
$48 + 6 = 54$, so there are $54$ inches in $4.5$ feet.

explanation: The conversion rate is $12$ inches for every $1$ foot, so feet are multiplied by $12$ to get inches.
Split $4.5$ feet into $4$ feet and half a foot to make the multiplication easy.
Four feet is $4 \times 12 = 48$ inches and half a foot is $6$ inches, which add to $54$.
There are $54$ inches in a length of $4.5$ feet.
